attacksRun.attack: the artifact cites namedCorpusNotAuthored as present on G26 v1 (my own attack)
attacksRun.evidence: The decisive structural trap, and the reason this artifact could not simply copy its siblings. Live harness.DR-G26.preview-analyze-sarif-not-advertised.preview.v1.json contains the substring 'namedCorpusNotAuthored' ZERO times and has no such key — unlike the G08, G10, G16, G19, and G23 harnesses, whose input corpora all legitimately say 'the N live namedCorpusNotAuthored classes'. Reproducing that sentence here would have been a fabricated field citation of exactly the kind the leftoverNameNote traps target. The subject does not: the token appears 0 times in it; authorityClaim says 'the live G26 v1 refuse-or-not-offer corpus' rather than naming the absent field; and basedOn.g26v1.role grounds explicitly on 'liveHarnessCellVerbatim and exactByteIntent are quoted' — both of which do exist. The corpus phrase it carries, 'refuse-or-not-offer corpus (DR-131 NT-5)', is verbatim the tail of the live liveHarnessCellVerbatim, and all three states use it as classMemberVerbatim.

OBL-G26-FX-AUTHORING remains leftover-design with the gate-row owner. All cited digests recomputed clean; HEAD 5d5d778; required-now 26. One observation: live EV-2's second limb about no projection harness having run is not carried.
